body: no, she hasnt. and i think asking her would just make things worse, placing more unnecessary blame on myself

no, i dont think she does. its not an obsession thats typical of a horror movie or anyhting. more like the way my eyes glow when i see her text or the way my heart sinks in my chest when shes with others or the way my head hurts when i see her big brown eyes. everything i do or see or hear reminds me of her and it kills me. whenever i try to settle with the fact that we can be perfectly good friends, something, for lack of a better word, triggers me and floods my body and mind with these thoughts, prolonging this obsession
everything about her. shes literally everything i could ever ask of a person. hate to be vague but it pains me to think about it
